crossRefs.note: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

translations.web: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
translations.bsb: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
translations.kjv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
translations.asv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.
